comment: Source statements whose target-language Wikipedia article describes the same entity with substantially different wording. Each entry documents the divergence so future automation can replay the same decision.

entries.source: .xxx — общий домен верхнего уровня, предлагаемый компанией ICM Registry для порнографических сайтов и порноиндустрии
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia frames the domain through its sponsoring registry; English Wikipedia frames it through ICANN sponsorship status and pornography hosting policy.

entries.source: Artemis II was a crewed flyby of the Moon
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia's first sentence introduces the mission as part of the broader NASA Artemis program and pairs it with the Orion spacecraft, omitting the crewed-flyby framing of the English lead.

entries.source: В настоящей статье представлен список людей, соответствующих критериям значимости, которые умерли в 2026 году
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia opens with a meta description of the list; English Wikipedia opens with a sentence about the deaths themselves and the entry format.

entries.source: WrestleMania 42, also promoted as WrestleMania Vegas, was a 2026 professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia leads with the ordinal numbering of the event; the English lead summarises the production and distribution details first.

entries.source: Since 28 February 2026, the United States and Israel have been engaged in a war with Iran and its regional allies
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia leads with the operation names ('Эпическая ярость', 'Рёв льва') before the participants; English Wikipedia leads with the date and participants.

entries.source: Michael is a 2026 biographical film directed by Antoine Fuqua and written by John Logan
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia describes the film as 'американский биографический музыкальный драматический фильм … о жизни и творчестве музыканта Майкла Джексона'; the English lead omits the subject of the biopic in the first sentence.

entries.source: Майкл Джо́зеф Дже́ксон — американский певец и автор песен
entries.reason: English Wikipedia uses past-tense biographical framing ('was an American singer, songwriter, dancer, and philanthropist'), while Russian Wikipedia uses present-tense identity framing.

entries.source: Project Hail Mary is a 2026 American epic science fiction film produced and directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller and written by Drew Goddard, based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir
entries.reason: The Russian Wikipedia title is translated as «Проект „Конец света“» and the lead omits the source novel and screenwriter; the English lead foregrounds them.

entries.source: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 12 April 2026 to elect all 199 members of the National Assembly
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia introduces the event as 'очередные выборы' and references the National Assembly without seat count; English Wikipedia foregrounds the seat count.

entries.source: The Drama is a 2026 American romantic black comedy film written and directed by Kristoffer Borgli
entries.reason: Russian Wikipedia title is «Вот это драма!» and characterizes the film as 'американская романтическая комедийная драма'; English Wikipedia uses the 'romantic black comedy' classification.
